integrity: Two independent cut-number predicates agree on every ternary factor of length at most eight. A full brute-force enumeration and an independent incremental suffix-checking enumeration produce identical complete avoiding sets, and the equality-layer symmetry partition is recomputed during replay.
scientific_limitations: The result is a finite ternary classification for cut number at most three. It does not determine whether t(3) is four or five, nor provide scalable bounds for larger cut thresholds. An unindexed computation may contain the same finite census.
title: The longest ternary 3-tangram-free words have length seven
